t06b6mp4.baseName: Ark Mat Snowman Christmas Decoration 82cm Festive Tree Garden Indoor Outdoor
t06b6mp4.variantName: Ark Mat Snowman Christmas Decoration 82cm Festive Tree Garden Indoor Outdoor
t06b6mp4.sourceDescription: Bring some festive fun to your Christmas display with this charming 82cm Snowman Tree decoration. With its eye-catching snowman design and practical 29 x 29 x 82cm size, it makes a great seasonal feature for creating a welcoming Christmas atmosphere. Perfect for adding character to your festive decorating, the snowman can be positioned in a variety of spaces around the home or as part of a larger Christmas display. Place it in a hallway, porch, conservatory or other suitable area to give your seasonal décor an extra festive touch. Whether you're creating a traditional Christmas scene or simply looking for a fun snowman decoration to complement your existing decorations, this 82cm design is an easy way to bring some Christmas cheer to your home. For indoor decorative use only. Keep the tree away from open flames, naked flames, candles, fireplaces, heaters and other sources of heat, as the materials may melt or ignite. Do not place the tree near fire or expose it to excessive heat. Ensure the tree is fully assembled according to the instructions and positioned on a stable, level surface to prevent it from tipping over. If decorative lights are added, use only suitable lights in accordance with the light manufacturer's instructions and ensure cables are not damaged or create a trip hazard. Keep packaging materials and small parts away from children. Inspect the tree before use and do not use it if any parts are damaged or broken. Retain these safety instructions for future reference. Ark Mat, The Storage Centre, West Park, Wellington, TA21 9AD info@ark-rubberandresin.co.uk 01392 209394

84my78qv.baseName: Walplus 300 LED String Lights Artificial Christmas Tree - Green - 210 cm
84my78qv.variantName: Walplus 300 LED String Lights Artificial Christmas Tree - Green - 210 cm
84my78qv.sourceDescription: This cone-shaped PVC Artificial Christmas Tree brings modern elegance to your seasonal decor with its sleek and simple design. It enhances any living space or garden, creating a festive presence with minimal ornamentation and maximum impact. Its visually appealing structure can serve as a centerpiece for gatherings, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere while maintaining a stylish appearance that aligns with contemporary aesthetics. Quality PVC Build The tree is constructed from high-quality PVC, known for its durability and weather resistance, making it suitable for both indoor and outdoor use. The material ensures longevity while mimicking the lush, evergreen foliage of a real tree, lending a natural look to your decor. Versatile LED Lighting Equipped with flexible LED strip lights, this tree offers warm white illumination that can be adapted to various settings. The USB connection allows for convenient powering options, enabling usage in multiple environments without the need for traditional power adapters. Modern Design With clean lines and a minimalist form, it fits seamlessly into modern decor styles. The understated elegance enhances any space, allowing you to decorate creatively with ornaments or lights for a personalized touch. Easy Installation Requires simple assembly with a screwdriver, accommodating those with minimal DIY experience. The straightforward setup ensures that your holiday preparation is stress-free so you can focus on the festive activities. Indoor &Outdoor Use Suitable for living rooms, gardens, and terraces, this tree adds charm both inside and outside. Its weather-resistant build makes it a flexible addition to your holiday decorations, approachable for various settings and scenarios. Product Specifications Colour: Green Material: PVC Tree height: 210 cm Bottom diameter: 105 cm Stand size: 45 x 45 cm Hinged construction for set up lightweight and break-resistant Lights type: LED strip lights Lights color: Warm white Number of LEDs: 300 Distance between LEDs: 1000 cm LED flash modes: 8 Power source: USB Batteries Included: No Voltage: 5 V Wattage: 5 W Indoor and sheltered outdoor use Assembly required: Yes Delivery-contains: 1 x Christmas tree 1 x Stand 1 x LED string light 1 x Peak 40 x 3 cm ball 40 x 4 cm ball 40 x 6 cm ball This product is powered by DC 5V, but the certified 5V USB power source is not included. Higher voltage may cause overheating to occur and may result in damage to the device and the potential risk of overheating and fiire. • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. This artificial tree is intended exclusively for indoor festive decoration. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. If using electric lights, ensure they are safety-certified and do not leave them turned on unattended. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd

hzevksh9.sourceDescription: Our 60cm Christmas Wreath with Pinecones is Christmas at its most natural. The full green foliage base is dressed with real pinecone accents – a warm, woodland look that needs no bows and no additional colour to feel finished. The natural pinecone detailing pairs beautifully with any colour scheme – warm whites, golds, and coppers, or a more neutral scandi aesthetic – making this one of the most versatile wreaths in the range.
